title: Tahoe Explorer: a Shiny app for exploring Tahoe-100M metadata
description: A Shiny application for exploring the metadata of the Tahoe-100M single-cell perturbation dataset. It summarizes drug, cell-line, sample, gene, and cell-level metadata in interactive charts, and assembles a filtered subset together with a reproducible R and Python pull recipe to plan downstream analysis. The cell-level observation table is queried lazily with duckdb, so the app runs without loading the full table into memory.
